- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
v- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
h- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
f- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
o- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
r- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
y- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
f- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
r- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
o- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
h- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
e- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
t- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
p- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
o- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
t- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
d- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
y- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
p- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
e- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
t- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
:- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
 - **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
e- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
 - **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
d- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
.- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
c- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
p- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
 - **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
o- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
 - **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
y- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
